· a desktop switch drives the mode, 12 s loop
Placement map at 4× · rail above as it looks in that mode
snapping
tiling
scrolling
The rail is the axis
2 px on the screen edge, cyan to rose. Every map cell, chip
underline and window frame samples it at its own x.
The map is the mode
Zones, tile rects or the strip, from the engine's own model.
New cells enter in 180 ms, old edges release over 720 ms.
No mode label anywhere: the shape says it.
Matched edges never blink
The 50/50 horizontal split exists in both the snapping layout
and the tile tree, so it is kept and re-parented, not redrawn.
The lens, scrolling only
A white outline marks the viewport on the strip. Columns
beyond the edge pack into the gutters at 1 px in their own hue.
The rail re-binds to the strip and shows the same slice of the
gradient, purple to rose here: you are near the end.
